claims.claim: The only published support channel for the Visa Developer Center is an email address, developer@visa.com, presented under 'Reach out to our team'.
claims.quote: Reach out to our team Email developer@visa.com
claims.title: Frequently Asked Questions
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: The address is Cloudflare-obfuscated in the HTML (data-cfemail) and was decoded locally; it renders as developer@visa.com on the page. The same page asks developers to include the X-CORRELATION-ID response header 'when you report your issues to Visa Developer (developer@visa.com)'. The homepage also has an 'Ask Our Team' button (class open-support-modal) whose modal content is JavaScript-rendered and was not captured.

claims.claim: Visa names the developer-facing support function 'Visa Developer Support' and routes account re-enablement through it by email.
claims.quote: Please contact Visa Developer Support at developer@visa.com to enable your account.
claims.title: Frequently Asked Questions
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: FAQ item 'My Visa Developer account is disabled. How do I enable it?'

claims.claim: In the April 2026 password-reset change notice the same function is called 'Visa Developer Platform Support', with no channel other than 'contact' given.
claims.quote: If the issue persists, contact Visa Developer Platform Support for assistance.
claims.title: Frequently Asked Questions
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Context: 'Starting April 28, 2026, We are updating the Forgot Password flow to improve security' (OTP replaces knowledge-based questions). Platform changes are communicated through FAQ entries on this page rather than a status or announcements feed.

claims.claim: The Visa Developer support page publishes no phone number, hours of operation, response-time commitment or ticketing system; it offers email, FAQs and a 'Contact Us' prompt only.
claims.quote: Need to Talk to Visa? Contact Us
claims.title: Frequently Asked Questions
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Absence finding. Full page read; sections are Forgot Password, MFA, Universal Login, Authentication & Account Management, then 'Find help your way' (guides, Learning Hub, email, Glossary, Use Cases & Blogs, Contact Us).

claims.claim: The Visa Developer Center Terms of Use state Visa has no obligation to provide support or maintenance for platform materials.
claims.quote: Visa has no obligation to provide support, maintenance, updates, upgrades, Modifications or new releases of any Materials
claims.title: Terms of Use
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Section 6.6 'No Support'. Version dated August 1, 2026. The Visa Core Rules (18 April 2026, section 7) separately bind Members: 'Where a Member uses an application programming interface (API) accessed through the Visa Developer Center (VDC), and that usage is not governed by a bespoke' agreement, the VDC Terms of Use apply.

claims.claim: Under the Terms of Use, an organisation that is not a Visa Member gets service, technical and implementation support from its sponsoring Visa Member, not from Visa.
claims.quote: alone responsible for their relationship, including, but not limited to, communicating about any Visa Product as well as service, technical and implementation support
claims.title: Terms of Use
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Clause on Agents: 'the Agent and its corresponding Visa Member are alone responsible for their relationship'. Consistent with the sponsor-mediated model on the Third Party Agent Registration page.

claims.claim: The Developer Platform includes an optional AI chatbot for informational support and an MCP code-generation service, both defined in the Terms as automated and not a communication with Visa.
claims.quote: an optional artificial intelligence (AI)-powered virtual assistant (“Chatbot”) designed to provide general, automated informational support about the Developer Platform’s features and benefits
claims.title: Terms of Use
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Section 'AI Virtual Assistant (Chatbot); Model Context Protocol (MCP) Code Generation Service'. Also: 'an optional code-generation tool using the Model Context Protocol (the “MCP Service”)'. The Terms say AI Interactions 'shall not be construed as any form of communications or interaction with any human individual or Visa'. The homepage loads /assets/js/vdp-ai-assist-element.js, described in a source comment as 'the AI Assist widget'.

claims.claim: Visa gives no availability commitment for the developer platform; the Terms provide it 'as is' and 'as available' without warranty.
claims.quote: ARE PROVIDED ON AN “AS IS”, “AS AVAILABLE”, “WITH ALL FAULTS” BASIS WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND.
claims.title: Terms of Use
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Absence of SLA. No 'service level' text anywhere in the Terms. Applies to 'DEVELOPER ACCOUNT, DEVELOPER PLATFORM (INCLUDING THE CHATBOT AND MCP SERVICE)'.

claims.claim: Going live on Visa Developer is a self-service Onboarding Dashboard flow, but credentials for certification and production are gated on a signed contract with Visa and no review timeline is published.
claims.quote: Credentials for certification and production will be provided once a signed relevant contract is in place between you and Visa.
claims.title: Going Live
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Page header: 'Updated to reflect the new onboarding experience available as of September 2025.' Steps: Business Entity Information, Business Entity Contact ('The contact will be notified when significant actions are required'), Project Information ('Visa will evaluate whether the products are suitable for your use case'), Request to Start Next Environment, API Registration, Users, Credentials and Encryption, CSR. The About page adds: 'the Visa team will review the project and work to develop a contract before a project is released and commercialized.'

claims.claim: Developer enablement is documentation-led: a Learning Hub with tutorials on the three authentication methods, outbound callbacks, going live and a Java Hello World walkthrough, plus separate Developer and Business quick-start guides.
claims.quote: Popular Tutorials & Guides Working with Visa APIs Read Here Authentication Guides Two-Way SSL Shared Secret (X-Pay Token) Message Level Encryption
claims.title: Visa Learning Hub
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: The About Visa Developer page claims 'Visa Developer has a blogs, tutorials, and webinars meant to help get you started' (Vendor), but no public webinars page was found (/pages/webinars returns 404); the archived community site had a 'Webinars' section.

claims.claim: Visa provides a downloadable desktop troubleshooting tool, VDC Playground, that handles all VDP authentication methods and can export details for bug reports; it is Windows-only and requires login to obtain.
claims.quote: Visa Developer Center Playground (VDC Playground) is a tool designed exclusively for testing and troubleshooting Visa APIs that are exposed through the Visa Developer Platform
claims.title: Visa Developer Center Playground
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: 'To access and download this tool, log in to Visa Developer > Project dashboard > Asset Management.' 'Save preferences and export details for reporting bug directly from the tool.' 'VDC Playground is currently compatible with Windows only.' Launched as an executable jar.

claims.claim: Visa Developer proactively emails project owners about expiring certificates on a fixed schedule, but only for projects promoted to certification or production, not sandbox.
claims.quote: Notifications will be sent 120, 90, 60, 30, 15 and 7 days prior to expiration.
claims.title: Frequently Asked Questions
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: 'Expiration notifications are sent for projects that have been promoted to certification and production environments only', to the 'owner' (full access) registered users. Two-way SSL certificates valid 27 months; X-Pay tokens 24 months.

claims.claim: Platform changes are communicated through public monthly release notes archived by year back to 2017, each item tagged with an availability level (Public or Restricted).
claims.title: Release Notes
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Most recent entry at fetch: 'May 2026 New Outbound API: Visa Digital Enablement Lite App ... Availability: Restricted'. No incident or status feed exists on developer.visa.com (see not_found).

claims.claim: For product availability questions the developer portal directs users to a regional Visa team or representative rather than a central support desk.
claims.quote: Please contact your regional team/representative for more information.
claims.title: Availability Matrix | Visa Developer Center Docs
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: The note appears against several products (e.g., Visa Flex Credential, Visa Offers Platform in Europe). Matrix covers North America, Asia-Pacific, Europe, CEMEA, LAC and 'will be updated periodically'.

claims.claim: Visa Developer Platform authentication is unified with the client portal: from November 5, 2025 it uses Visa's Universal Login, and users signing in through Visa Access SSO skip MFA.
claims.quote: If you access the Visa Developer Platform (VDP) through Visa Access Single Sign‑On (SSO), you will not be prompted for MFA.
claims.title: Frequently Asked Questions
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: 'Starting November 5, 2025, Visa Developer Platform will use Visa’s Universal Login for authentication ... managed by Visa’s B2BIAM platform.' MFA options: email OTP (default), SMS, authenticator app; passkeys optional (Windows Hello or FIDO2 key; not iPhone/iPad/Android). The Visa Partner FAQ carries the same programme for VPP: 'Coming in February 2026, Visa Partner Platform (VPP) will require Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) at login'.

claims.claim: Visa ran a peer-support Developer Community (Khoros-style forum) with 26.1K members and topic boards including 'Visa Direct Support' and 'Go Live & Pricing'; the live host now refuses TLS connections and the last Wayback capture is 9 July 2025.
claims.quote: 26.1K Members 3,520 Discussions 1,004 Solutions
claims.title: Home - Visa Developer Community
claims.publisher: Visa Developer Community (Visa Inc.), Wayback Machine capture
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Archived copy of Visa's own page, captured 2025-07-09. Forum list: New to Visa Developer; Two-way SSL & X-Pay Token; Sandbox & Test Data; Implementation & API Sample Code; Product Docs & Reference Data; Go Live & Pricing; Visa Dev Community Chatter; Product Updates & Release Notes; Use Cases; Partnering with Visa; Message Level Encryption; Visa Direct Support; Blogs; Tutorials; Webinars. 'Sign in to Ask a Question'. Featured posts were by a 'Visa Employee' (2023–2024). Live URL https://community.developer.visa.com/ failed with SSLV3_ALERT_HANDSHAKE_FAILURE from WebFetch, curl and Python on 2026-09-25; Wayback CDX shows no capture after 20250709. developer.visa.com's homepage no longer links to a community, but partner.visa.com/site/about-us.html still links 'Talk with other developers' to it. Visa's GitHub org (16 public repos, blog field = developer.visa.com) accepts issues on trusted-agent-protocol (18 open) but its README has no support or contact section.

claims.claim: Visa Partner support is a single email alias, visapartner@visa.com, for website and account questions; lockouts and disabled accounts are also resolved by emailing the support team.
claims.quote: For any questions related to this website or your account, please reach out to visapartner@visa.com.
claims.title: Visa Partner Support and FAQ
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Address decoded from Cloudflare data-cfemail. Lockouts: 'Please reach out to our support team. This will allow you to change your password through an email delivered to your inbox.' Disabled: 'You will need to email us with the same email address you used to register, to re-enable.' The Contact Us page (partner.visa.com/site/contact-us.html) embeds visapartner@visa.com and fintech@visa.com. No hours or response times published.

claims.claim: One Visa Partner account spans the Developer APIs, partner programmes and Visa Online, but Visa Online access requires additional validation.
claims.quote: An account on Visa Partner also gets you access to Visa Developer APIs, Visa Partner programs, and Visa Online services.
claims.title: Visa Partner Support and FAQ
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Next sentence: 'Please note, Visa Online does require additional validation before access is granted.' Partner application forms run on a third-party cloud: 'allow the third-party cookies for the following domain: https://visa.appiancloud.com'.

claims.claim: Visa Partner's 'Learn' curriculum for pre-seed to Series A entrants is three short video courses (about 9 to 11 minutes each) on the four-party model, transaction lifecycle and launching a card programme.
claims.quote: Steps to Launch a Payments Program Walk through the steps to launch a physical or digital card program.
claims.title: Visa Partner | Learn
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Courses: 'Overview of Payments & Card Product Solutions' (11:06), 'Transaction Lifecycle, Interchange & Portfolio Economics' (11:07), 'Steps to Launch a Payments Program' (09:26). 'Ideal for You if… You are a new to payments or an entrepreneur (Pre-seed, Seed and Series A business stage)'. The developer FAQ points to this section for ecosystem questions.

claims.claim: Visa Ready certified partners are promised solution-development support including implementation guides, a Visa Integration Manager, pilot testing frameworks and workshops, plus go-to-market collateral.
claims.quote: Solution development support Implementation guides Visa Integration Manager Pilot testing frameworks Workshops
claims.title: Visa Ready Program
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Marketing list under 'Fuel your solution's growth'. Eligible applicants: 'Technology partners, issuer processors, BIN sponsors, program managers, acquirers, and gateways'. Programme claims '500+ partners 11+ product verticals 160+ solutions 20+ countries' (Vendor). Six-step path: find programme, create Visa Partner account, apply, get certification approved, access resources, get listed in the partner directory.

claims.claim: Visa's public pages assume clients have a named Visa account executive as their relationship contact.
claims.quote: Contact a partner via directory listings or reach out to your Visa account executive
claims.title: Visa Ready Program
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Step 2 of 'Work with a Visa Ready partner'. Corroborated by open Workday postings for 'Director, Account Executive' in New York, Washington DC and San Francisco (visa.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com, 2026-09-25).

claims.claim: For most third-party agents, Visa's support relationship is mediated by a sponsoring issuer or acquirer that acts as liaison; only agents enrolling in non-sponsored products register directly with Visa.
claims.quote: A Visa Client sponsor serves as a liaison between you and Visa
claims.title: Visa Partner | Third Party Agent Registration
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: 'The Visa product team overseeing the service you are enrolling in will assist you in determining if a Visa Client sponsor is required during onboarding.' Vendor claim on the same page: 'Visa provides support and resources to registered agents, including payments training, technical support, and marketing assistance'.

claims.claim: Visa Acceptance Solutions publishes a response commitment of 1 to 2 business days for developer support requests submitted by form, with a masked phone number and peer channels on GitHub and Stack Overflow.
claims.quote: Please allow 1-2 business days for us to respond.
claims.title: Contact us | Visa Acceptance Developer Portal
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Phone shown as 'Call us at #######' in text but the link is tel:1-800-530-9095. Form fields: name, email, Merchant ID (MID), API Feature (includes 'AI Assistant', 'Developer MCP SDK', 'Intelligent Commerce Connect'), programming language, issue summary, error message. Peer help: 'Or get help from the Visa Acceptance developer community' linking github.com/CyberSource and stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/cybersource. Production issues are redirected: 'For questions about processing transactions, enabling services in Production or unlocking your account, please contact Client Services.' Sandbox is self-serve: 'After completing the evaluation registration process, you will be able to send test transactions' but 'You should not perform load or stress testing in the sandbox'.

claims.claim: Visa Acceptance's Support Center offers live chat and support-case submission, but both are behind sign-in; unauthenticated visitors get knowledge articles only.
claims.quote: Sign in to view additional content, start a chat or submit a support case.
claims.title: Home | Visa Acceptance Support Center
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Portal covers 'our Visa Acceptance Solutions and Cybersource portfolios'. Sign-in routes to businesscenter.visaacceptance.com/ebc2/ or Visa SSO (sso.trusted.visa.com). Popular topics: Getting started, Reason/decline codes, Security keys, Reports, Refunds/voids, Business center access.

claims.claim: Visa Acceptance's 'Client Services' function is reachable by online chat, support case (General Support Request or MID Configuration Request) and phone, with the available methods varying by client agreement.
claims.quote: This article describes the available methods for contacting Client Services, including online chat, support case submission, and phone contact.
claims.title: Support - Contacting Client Services | Visa Acceptance Support Center
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Article 000002076, version 14.2, 'Last Modified Date 09/23/2026'. 'Available contact methods may vary depending on your client agreement.' Account-specific contacts are shown after sign-in under 'Contact Us'. No hours of operation are stated ('Availability may vary by region').

claims.claim: Client Services phone support is regionalised with more than 20 country numbers, separate Visa Acceptance Solutions numbers for North America and Global, and a legacy Cybersource USA/Canada line.
claims.quote: USA and Canada 1-800-709-7779 Latin America and Caribbean (LAC) +1-877-580-1131 Central Europe, Middle East, and Africa (CEMEA) +44 (0) 203 564 4099
claims.title: Support - Contacting Client Services | Visa Acceptance Support Center
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Also: 'Asia Pacific (AP) +65 6818 5380', country lines for Australia, China, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Japan, Korea, New Zealand, Philippines, Singapore, Taiwan, Thailand, Vietnam, and 'Visa Acceptance Solutions North America 855-477-5028 Visa Acceptance Solutions Global +1 650-432-2186'. Language limitation: 'The LAC phone number currently connects to English-language support only. If you require Spanish-language support, submit a support case instead.'

claims.claim: Incident communication for Visa Acceptance Solutions is a public Atlassian Statuspage with email and SMS subscriptions, RSS/Atom feeds and an incident history; it lists the Developer Center and Support Center as monitored components.
claims.quote: We use this page to communicate service availability and status for Visa Acceptance Solutions. Subscribe to get real-time updates via Email, SMS.
claims.title: Visa Acceptance Solutions Status
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: 'All Systems Operational' at fetch. Components include API Connection/Endpoints (Flex, Rest API, Webhooks), 'Corporate and Support Web Sites' (Corporate Site, Developer Center, Status Page, Support Center), Payment Gateway Processing by processor (e.g., Chase Paymentech, Elavon, WorldPay), Visa Platform Connect gateways. Subscription terms reference 'the Atlassian Terms of Service'. A parallel page at https://status.cybersource.com/ ('Cybersource Status') remains live with the older component list (SCMP, Simple Order API, SOAP Toolkit). No equivalent status page exists for the Visa Developer Center.

claims.claim: The Cybersource Developer Community (still linked as 'Support & Community' from the Visa Acceptance developer portal) had 64.5K members but only 513 Cybersource discussions versus 10,964 Authorize.net discussions, and its announcements block still carries 2011-era notices; the live host bot-walls automated fetches.
claims.quote: 1,666 Solutions 10.9K Discussions 64.5K Members
claims.title: Home - Cybersource Developer Community
claims.publisher: Cybersource Developer Community (Visa Inc.), Wayback Machine capture
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Archived 2026-05-14. 'Cybersource Developer Community 513 discussions Authorize.net Developer Community 10964 discussions'. Recent posts (May 2026) show '0 replies'. Stale announcement text: 'Authorize.Net will be exhibiting at the 2011 Mobile Commerce Forum, in Houston, TX, October 10th through 12th.' Live URL returned HTTP 403 'Just a moment...' (Cloudflare) to curl and WebFetch on 2026-09-25. The community is still Cybersource-branded although the portal that links to it is Visa Acceptance-branded.

claims.claim: The client portal formerly branded Visa Online is now defined in the Visa Rules as 'Visa Access', a password-protected site for Members, VisaNet Processors and other authorised users.
claims.quote: A password-protected website that provides Members, VisaNet Processors, and other authorized users with access to Visa information, formerly known as Visa Online.
claims.title: Visa Core Rules and Visa Product and Service Rules
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Glossary entry ID# 0025360, p.904 (Edition Apr 2026, Last Updated Apr 2025). https://www.visaonline.com/ redirects to a login page (secure.visaonline.com) titled 'Index' with no public description. Related gated self-service tools defined at ID# 0026479: 'Client Portfolio Management Self-Service Tools ... comprising the following: Program Request Management (PRM), Electronic Client Information Questionnaire (eCIQ), Visa Client Support Application (VCSA)'. The 'Client Service Provider Directory' is 'used for Member-to-Member communication and problem resolution' (ID# 0030656). Monthly account statements 'can be consulted in Visa Access' (ID# 0031178).

claims.claim: Visa's operational communications to clients go by email to two mandated roles per Member, the Primary Center Manager and a Senior Officer, and include the weekly Visa Business News.
claims.quote: Primary operational contact who receives all critical corporate and operational email communications from Visa that may be urgent or require a response
claims.title: Visa Core Rules and Visa Product and Service Rules
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Glossary ID# 0031041 (Primary Center Manager) and ID# 0031042: 'The Senior Officer receives the same email communications as the Primary Center Manager, including the weekly Visa Business News.' Rule 2.1.3.1 (ID# 0007725) requires Members to register these contacts 'in the My Organization’s Contacts module of the Client Directory via Visa Access' within 10 business days of a BID implementation or change. Visa Business News itself is gated.

claims.claim: Visa's public merchant support page is a document library with no contact channel; merchants get a periodic digest of Visa Business News rather than direct access to it.
claims.quote: The Visa Merchant Business News Digest provides a summary of recent Visa Business News publications that highlight key merchant-related publications.
claims.title: Merchant Resource Library | Visa
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Seed https://usa.visa.com/support/merchant.html redirects here. 'Updated periodically.' Library categories: Best Practices, Disputes, Security and Risk, EMV. No phone, email, form or hours on the page. WebFetch of the same page also found 'no direct merchant support contact information'.

claims.claim: Visa University, Visa's client training arm, commits to a 1 to 2 business-day response on its contact form, which includes a 'BID inquiry' category for client institutions.
claims.quote: A member of our support team will respond to your inquiry within 1-2 business days.
claims.title: Contact Us | Visa University
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Form topics: Course question, Course enrollment, Account issue, BID inquiry, Not receiving emails, Payment/billing question, Digital Payments Library, certificate/certification programmes, Exams, Cancellation request. Site offered in English, Español and Português; the FAQ page HTML embeds support.visauniversity@visa.com. Vendor claim on About page: 'We support financial institutions of all sizes, across all times zones and in multiple languages.' The seed usa.visa.com/partner-with-us/visa-university.html returns 404; the site lives at visauniversity.com.

claims.claim: Visa University runs exam-based professional certifications (Dispute Resolution, Payments Cybersecurity, Portfolio Management) with digital badges, alongside a seven-week Wharton co-branded certificate and a 1,200-video streaming library.
claims.quote: Our certification programs consist of required exams with recommended courses that help you prepare to take the exams.
claims.title: Visa Certification | Visa University
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Homepage: 'Digital Payments Catalyst A seven-week certificate program pairing the academic excellence of Wharton faculty with the real-world expertise of Visa leaders' with 'Registration for our September 2026 program is now open'; 'Digital Payments Library ... featuring 1,200+ videos, 17 courses, 20+ playlists'. Blended format: self-paced content opens two weeks before 'Live class sessions (two days, four to six hours per day)' with a pre-class office hour; completion yields 'a digital badge issued by Visa University'. Course topics: Dispute Resolution, Fraud, Operations, Payments Cybersecurity, Payments Landscape, Portfolio Management. Pricing not checked.

claims.claim: Visa University offers both open-enrolment courses and private, organisation-specific training, and says it has done so for over 15 years.
claims.quote: We offer open enrollment courses where you can exchange ideas and knowledge with peers from different companies around the globe, and private training
claims.title: About Visa University | Visa University
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: 'For over 15 years, we’ve provided payments professionals with the tools and training they need' (Vendor). Faculty: 'some of Visa’s most tenured and experienced professionals as well as experts from around the payments industry'. The FY2025 10-K mentions Visa University only as an employee benefit ('Visa University learning pathways').

claims.claim: Visa's FY2025 10-K describes Visa Consulting and Analytics as its payments consulting arm for issuers, acquirers, sellers and fintechs, but contains no description of a client-services or client-support organisation.
claims.quote: Operating as the payments consulting arm of Visa, Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) utilizes our payments expertise and economic intelligence to identify actionable insights
claims.title: Visa Inc. Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2025
claims.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (EDGAR), filed by Visa Inc.
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Full text searched: 'client services' 0 hits, 'client support' 0, 'Visa Online' 0, 'Visa Developer' 0, 'service level' 0. Only 'Professional fees ... expenses associated with client engagements' and 'value-added services' (25 hits). Filed after Capital One's 18 May 2025 acquisition of Discover; not relevant to Visa's own structure. The public VCA page (visa.com/en-us/solutions/visa-consulting-analytics) offers a 'Connect with VCA' form only.

claims.claim: Visa's relationship-management function is organised as 'Client Services' with regional heads (e.g., Central Europe and Eurozone Operations) and a 'Client Success' team undergoing transformation, per a September 2026 job posting.
claims.quote: The Director Client Success reports to the Head of Client Services Central Europe and Eurozone Operations and is based in Frankfurt.
claims.title: Director Client Success (REF088752W)
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Fetched via the Workday public job API (visa.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/wday/cxs/visa/Visa/job/...). 'This role provides an opportunity to contribute to our Client Success transformation.' Visa moved careers from SmartRecruiters to Workday; SmartRecruiters API returns 0 postings.

claims.claim: Visa's account-management model pairs a Client Success manager who owns post-sale service, operational support and a Client Success Plan with a separate Account Team, and explicitly pushes clients toward self-service tools.
claims.quote: managing a portfolio of strategic client accounts and leading a team that delivers high-quality post-sale service and operational support
claims.title: Director Client Success (REF088752W)
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: 'Develop, execute, and monitor Client Success Plans for your own clients, in alignment with the Account Team.' 'Drive and deliver initiatives that improve client adoption of Visa products and promote the use of self-service tools.' 'Monitor and report on health metrics for your own clients.' Tiering language is limited to 'strategic client accounts'; no public tier definitions found.

claims.claim: Implementation of new Visa products for clients and processors is project-managed by regional Implementation Analysts who also support the twice-yearly business enhancement releases and Visa mandates.
claims.quote: Lead project management of implementations for Visa client institutions and processors in assigned region to ensure customer expectations are exceeded.
claims.title: Implementation Analyst (Mandarin Speaking) (REF088816W)
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: 'Support biannual business enhancements and all Visa mandates.' 'Act as liaison for the client, provide problem management, proactive identification of processing efficiencies, service change support, and system enhancement support.' 'Report client project accomplishments and deliverables to management monthly.' Based in Manila, Mandarin-speaking, serving an assigned region (language-specific regional support).

claims.claim: Visa Developer launched in 2016 with roughly 155 APIs and a sandbox, per trade press at the time.
claims.quote: The new program, called Visa Developer, embraces some 155 APIs and includes such new services as Visa Checkout, Visa Alerts, and Visa Direct
claims.title: Visa's Bid to Woo Developers
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Byline 'Digital Transactions News staff'. Also: 'It also features a so-called sandbox that will let developers test new apps before releasing them into the marketplace.' Historical context only; no later trade-press coverage of Visa's developer or client support model was found (search budget exhausted; site searches on Digital Transactions, Payments Dive and PYMNTS returned nothing on topic).
